# APN Real Estate

> Real estate agency in South Australia with offices in Adelaide (Blair Athol) and Mount Gambier: residential sales, leasing and property management. Formerly Adelaide Property Network. Free sales and rental appraisals.

Adelaide Property Network | RLA 255336 | ACN 164 181 971

APN Real Estate was founded as Adelaide Property Network by Patrick Nhim, who leads the sales team. Sales and property management work side by side. Property management covers finding and screening tenants, collecting rent, routine and entry/exit inspections, coordinating maintenance and repairs, and keeping owners informed. Fees and commission depend on the property; ask for an appraisal for a specific answer.

Phone: 1300 123 276 (both offices)
Opening hours: Monday to Saturday, 8:30am to 5:00pm (both offices)

## Offices

- [Adelaide](https://apnre.com.au/contact/#adelaide): Level 1 / 420B, Cnr Main North Road and Barton Street, Blair Athol SA 5084
- [Mount Gambier](https://apnre.com.au/contact/#mount-gambier): 178 Commercial Street East, Mount Gambier SA 5290
